name: Can I replace just a section of my window sill, or do I need to replace the entire thing?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just a section of my window sill, or do I need to replace the entire thing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can replace just a section or need to replace the entire sill depends on the extent and location of the damage. If the damage is isolated to a small, non-structural part of the sill and the rest is sound, a localized repair might be possible. However, if the damage is widespread, structural, or indicates a deeper moisture problem, a full replacement is usually the more durable and effective solution. Maine Results, Inc. can assess the damage to determine the most appropriate and long-lasting repair method for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Partial replacement is possible for isolated, non-structural damage, but widespread issues typically require full sill replacement.
